dishes.name: Longeole
dishes.desc: Fennel-scented pork sausage with a protected geographical status, cooked in the oven or simmered and served with potatoes or lentils. A Geneva countryside speciality.

dishes.name: Cardon gratin
dishes.desc: Cardoon baked with béchamel and cheese. The Geneva cardoon has a protected designation and the dish is a Geneva Christmas tradition, found in autumn and winter.

dishes.name: Cheese fondue
dishes.desc: Melted Swiss cheeses with white wine, eaten with bread from a shared pot. Geneva serves the classic version in its old brasseries and cafés through the colder months.

dishes.name: Pain de Genève
dishes.desc: Soft, lightly sweet bread from the Geneva region. Bakers in the city still bake it as a local alternative to the standard roll.
